section_summary.extract_value: This Results section reports psychometric analyses of the BAS-2, including EFAs conducted on two randomly split groups (n=338 and n=337), which were combined for final analyses. It reports internal consistency, test–retest reliability (subsample n=208), construct/criterion/incremental validity, and the correlation between BAS-2 and BMI (overall r = -0.27; women r = -0.23; men r = -0.32).
